scope: User-authorized single-operating-point relaxation: bounded multi-regime measured history only

sampling.warmup: Before all slots exist, zero absent slots; retain every original decision in denominators

inputs_description: Each176-vector is unchanged standardized174 measured features + observation flag + original gap age. Three slots retain multiple operating regimes during ramps. No U, ucrit, margin, simulator poles, design identity, commanded schedule, future data or extra sensors enters predictor. Regime-span labels are scoring-only. Current causal calibration/timebase conventions retained.
normalization: Use original proper clean/IID1 train-only feature scaling; missing feature values zero after scaling; observation and age unchanged. No per-target velocity normalization or pooling of V.

controls.repeated_current: Three copies of current176-vector; identical528 input width and32->16 model. Controls capacity/init/regularization changes.
controls.unordered_history: Repeat average of three causal176-vectors; same528 width/aperture, suppresses slot ordering.
controls.shuffled_past: Keep current176-vector; two past slots from another physical trajectory within same split/noise condition via fixed permutation20261011, consistent across noise views. Counterfactual control, not deployable; no donor future used.

training.learner: framewise32->16 ReLU; only input columns differ
training.loss: Existing all-frame mean squared error on proper clean/IID1 trajectories, including original gap behavior
training.selection: Original clean/IID1 validation all-frame MAE only; no fresh-noise/held selection

evaluation.fresh_population: Same held physical trajectories only, no new designs or fitting on fresh noise
evaluation.noise: Existing original-eight aggregate causal prefixRMS sigma; same white draw for paired IID/correlated, rho=.8 and realized per-channel marginal RMS matched; never percent of decaying response

regime_scoring: Past/current label span >=.005 after384ms warmup marks distinct regimes; <=1e-10 marks dwell; remainder weak change. No truth-conditioned acquisition, fitting, masking or model selection.
acceptance: Evidence for within-design history requires overall/boundary improvement relative to single128 AND capacity-matched repeated_current/shuffled_past across primary conditions, design/seed stability, no dangerous sign/optimism regressions, explicit dwell/ramp/gap behavior. Improvements versus pooled history can suggest ordering value. No qualification or safety claim from accuracy alone.
limits: Ordinary128ms source windows already have within-window changing velocity; not a literal constant-speed vs variable-speed experiment

This is bounded waveform-only multi-regime history, NOT an independently scheduled known-speed sweep. Larger velocity-span/known-U calibration would require separately explicit information/acquisition choices
